Outcome of Board Meeting — NACL Industries Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended December 31, 2025.

Disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations — Coromandel International Limited has submitted to the Exchange a copy of Disclosures under Regulation 10(6)-Report to stock Exchange in respect of any acquisition made in reliance upon exemption provided for in regulation 10 of SEBI (SAST) Regulations, 20
Allotment of Securities — NACL Industries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding allotment of 32501851 securities pursuant to Rights Issue at its meeting held on December 31, 2025
General Updates — Letter of Offer dated December 8, 2025 for Rights issue of fully paid up Equity Shares.

Rights Issue — NACL Industries Limited has informed the Exchange that Board of Directors at its meeting held on December 08, 2025, has decided to issue equity shares on rights basis in the ratio of 5 : 31, i.e 5 Equity Shares for every 31 Equity Shares held. Issue Price is Rs. 76 per share.
Cessation — NACL Industries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Cessation of Mr Anish T Mathew  as Chief Financial Officer of the company w.e.f. December 01, 2025.
General Updates — NACL Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about Board comments on fine levied by the Exchange
